nav.sidebarHint: Compliance workspace — roles and data from your organization.

dashboard.title: Compliance overview
dashboard.intro: Each area below maps to obligations under the Working Environment Act and related rules. Configuration, copy, and permissions live in the database and Supabase policies—not in the application code.
dashboard.overviewPlaceholder: Activity and status charts will appear here when modules are connected.
dashboard.quickTaskDesc: Track statutory duties, deadlines, and checklists.
dashboard.quickInviteDesc: Send an invitation with a role from organization settings.
dashboard.pendingEmpty: No pending items. Tasks and signatures will show here when available.

modules.tasksDesc: Follow-up actions, deadlines, and evidence for statutory duties.
modules.workCouncilDesc: Meetings with fixed agendas, participants, minutes, voting, and audit trail.
modules.hseDesc: Health, safety, and environment registers aligned with the internal control duty.
modules.documentsDesc: Handbooks, risk assessments, and procedures with structured pages and uploads.
modules.surveysDesc: MAP and other surveys to assess and improve the psychosocial environment.
modules.reportsDesc: Confidential reporting channel with case handling and access control.
modules.learningDesc: Courses with rich content, quizzes, flash cards, and JSON import/export.
modules.settingsDesc: Invitations, roles, locales, and integration settings.

modules.tasksPlaceholder: Task templates, assignments, due dates, and checklist items are stored per organization. Connect this view to Supabase queries and mutations.
modules.workCouncilPlaceholder: Plan meetings, enforce agenda order, record attendance, append-only audit log, and run ballots for elected roles—all scoped to your organization.
modules.hsePlaceholder: Risk assessments, inspections, incidents, and action tracking with RLS tied to HSE roles.
modules.documentsPlaceholder: Hierarchical wiki spaces, versioned rich text (same editor as courses), and file attachments in Supabase Storage with metadata in Postgres.
modules.surveysPlaceholder: Anonymous or identified surveys, recurring campaigns, and reporting for the psychosocial working environment.
modules.reportsPlaceholder: Report intake, triage workflow, and strict separation of duties for reviewers.
modules.learningPlaceholder: Author courses, add flash cards, short messages, media blocks, and quizzes; export and import course definitions as JSON for admins.
modules.settingsPlaceholder: Organization profile, locales, invitations, and role assignments mapped to legal responsibilities.

compliance.title: Legal mapping (data-driven)
compliance.subtitle: These rows are seeded from the Working Environment Act structure. Extend or edit them in the database; the UI only reads them.

auth.loginSubtitle: Use your work email and password.
auth.registerSubtitle: You will be the organization administrator. You can invite teammates afterward.
auth.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens. Used in URLs.
auth.authError: Sign-in failed. Try again or request a new link.
auth.confirmEmail: Check your email to confirm your account, then sign in.
auth.inviteRegisterHint: Use the same email address the invitation was sent to.
auth.onboardingSubtitle: You are signed in but not yet linked to an organization.
auth.invalidSlug: Use a valid slug: at least 2 characters, lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
auth.inviteAlreadyHaveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.inviteMissingToken: This link is missing the invitation token.
auth.inviteExpiredOrInvalid: This invitation is invalid or has expired. Ask your administrator for a new invite.

lms.catalogIntro: Default courses for every organization appear first; your company can add its own published courses below.
lms.needOrg: Join or create an organization to see the catalog.
lms.noSystemCourses: No default courses yet. A platform administrator can publish system courses.
lms.noCompanyCourses: No organization courses yet. Authors can add them in the studio.
lms.studioIntro: Design courses with modular blocks (quiz, flash cards, micro-lessons, and more). Publish when ready.
lms.noAuthorAccess: You need the learning author role or org admin to edit company courses.
lms.platformAdminHint: To manage default courses for all companies, your user must be listed in the platform_admins table (run in SQL as a superuser).
lms.scopeHelp: System courses are visible to all members once published. Only platform admins can create or edit them.
lms.jsonPlaceholder: Paste exported JSON to replace all sections…

settingsInvites.invitesSubtitle: Create a secure link for a specific email and role. Only organization administrators can send invites.

settingsInvites.invitesAdminOnly: Only organization administrators can manage invitations.
